alex: Thinking out loud — proposal to add a lightweight 'shipyard' CLI alias + a deploy-bot command for quick escape-hatches and release templates. small, low-risk change but would cut the noise during late-night rollouts :coffee:

sylvia: yes please. current flow is: edit huge manifest -> run deploy -> copy notes. we need a simple generator and a one-line rollback key.

jamal: sketch: `/ship deploy --template=lite --window=0300-0500 --pin=service@v2.3 --pr=1234` returns a deployment id and an ephemeral rollback token.

alex: exact idea: deploy-bot returns two things: deployment_id and rollback_token. rollback_token is single-use, time-limited (default 30m). Operators can run `/ship rollback <token>` or `/ship rollback --id <deployment_id>` if they want full auth flow. keeps keyboard work minimal. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: queued deploy 2250001234-1 for staging (team: payments). ETA 90s. rollback_token: HJ7xd-REDACT (expires in 30m). Run `/ship rollback HJ7xd-REDACT` to undo staging.

jamal: can we make the token automatically annotate the release notes with the rollback reason when used? would help audits.

alex: yes — token -> details stored in release meta. we already have audit hooks, just add `rollback_reason` field.

sylvia: also propose a tiny `release-lite` template that outputs a one-paragraph summary and bullet points for risk/monitoring commands. sample output: 
```
Summary: v2.3 updates cache layer to avoid N+1 on embeddings.
Risk: increased cold-start latency for first 100 requests.
Monitoring: svc:tail logs, metrics:redis_hits, latency_p50/p95.
Quick rollback: /ship rollback <token>
```

alex: +1. Also adding `--change-window` flag to mark the event in calendar/ops channel automatically. `/ship deploy --template=lite --change-window=UTC+0:03:00-05:00` -> posts pinned note in #eng-oncall and creates incident annotation.

ops-bot: noted. created calendar event "shipyard: payments v2.3" at 2025-07-14T03:00Z and pinned deploy message in #eng-oncall.

jamal: one more: provide a tiny bash snippet for local dry-run that devs can use: 
```bash
# shipyard dry-run helper
cat release.json | jq 'del(.secrets)' > release-slim.json
ship --dry-run deploy --file release-slim.json --template lite
```

alex: love it. plan: i’ll open a small RFC with the command surface + deploy-bot changes. if no objections by EOD Friday i'll ship a PoC. wanted to surface here in case any rollout edge cases we missed.

sylvia: FYI: include a guard to prevent rollback tokens from being accepted for prod after 10m unless user has 2fa or admin role. security asked for that.

alex: good catch — will add role check and MFA requirement toggle.

deploy-bot: follow-up: implemented token TTL and single-use in the PoC branch `shipyard/token-ttl`. demo tomorrow in the morning sync. :rocket:
